The '''Mofference room''' was a chamber aboard the [[Central Committee of Grand Moffs]]' [[Moffship]] in which [[Mofference]]s were held. It was large and secluded, and it was accessed by a thick metal door. A Mofference occurred in the Mofference Room in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].
